tickets.title: Synergy detection and firing rules
tickets.description: Resolve in priority order (Cataclysm x Law, then Cataclysm x Powers, then Law x Powers, then Pressure, then Anomaly), cap at two active per seed, stop checking once two fire.

tickets.title: Synergy override pipeline
tickets.description: A fired synergy overrides default flavour text and injects its faction, dungeon type and world name into WorldConfig.

tickets.title: Two-tier synergy content model
tickets.description: Tier 1 gets faction + dungeon type + mechanic; Tier 2 is text-only. Most players never know which they got.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Artemis Withdrew + Hecatomb (the Hekatombaia)
tickets.description: No beasts left to sacrifice, and the rites specify quantities. Human levy administered with immaculate procedure; bottled vitality as currency. Iphigenia as precedent rather than tragedy.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Deukalion's Flood + Orichalcum (the dive guilds)
tickets.description: The orichalcum is Atlantean and under the water - this synergy is simply the myth. Diving as a progression axis, pressurised wrecks, air management.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Demeter's Grief + The Mysteries (the Hierophants)
tickets.description: The Eleusinian Mysteries were Demeter's cult and promised Persephone's return. She did not return, so the central rite of the world demonstrably failed and every initiate was sold an afterlife that is not coming.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Silence of the Oracles + The Oath (the Oathkeepers)
tickets.description: The gods witnessed and guaranteed oaths. With them silent nobody can be released from one, so everyone is bound by oaths their grandparents swore. Sworn power is traceable.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Silence of the Oracles + The Amphictyony (the composed oracle)
tickets.description: The league governing the great sanctuary knows the oracle has said nothing for two centuries and has been composing its pronouncements ever since. An information-control thriller with a real institution at its centre.

tickets.title: Tier 1: The Unbinding + Temenos (the sacred ways)
tickets.description: The earth broke along the sacred ways; the chasms are where the temene were. Vertical traversal and divine strength become one axis.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Artemis Withdrew + The Satrapy (the invaders' animals)
tickets.description: The only living beasts belong to the occupiers. A horse on the horizon means enemy, with no UI. Cheap to implement, enormously evocative.

tickets.title: Tier 1: Deukalion's Flood + The League (trade as life support)
tickets.description: The League exists because the flood made shipping the only survival mechanism. Nothing grows, all grain is imported, and the player can starve or save a polis by touching its shipping.

tickets.title: Tier 1: The Mysteries + The Amphictyony (sacrilege)
tickets.description: Initiation controlled by the temple league; unauthorised initiation is a capital charge. Attested - profaning the Mysteries nearly ended Alcibiades. Learning power IS becoming a criminal.

tickets.title: Tier 1: The Age of Kronos + The Last Favour (the conspiracy)
tickets.description: The golden age persists on dwindling divine attention and perhaps nine people have done the arithmetic. Tonal inversion - intrigue, not survival.

tickets.title: Tier 2 synergy pool: Pressure combinations
tickets.description: Flood + Opening, Mysteries + Miasma, Oath + Return, Artemis + Unburied, Orichalcum + Foretold. Text-only, an afternoon each.

tickets.title: Tier 3 synergy pool: Anomaly combinations
tickets.description: Tiresias + Silence of the Oracles, the Labyrinth + the Unbinding, the reachable underworld + the Unburied, the door in the sea + the Flood.

tickets.title: Triple synergies
tickets.description: ~1% of seeds. Silence + Oath + Return; Artemis + Hecatomb + Famine; Flood + Orichalcum + League.
